name: novatools/novatools-polyglot
description: Comprehensive multilingual add-on for NovaTools — language management, content translation, string translation, PO/MO editing, WooCommerce multilingual, and WPML migration.
_comment_autoload: The autoload config is used during development (composer dump-autoload). In production, the custom PSR-4 autoloader in vendor/autoload.php is used instead to avoid requiring composer install on deploy.
